decision_scope: Closes full-ocean age support authority and selects an explicit ARCANA HWR-2 numerical configuration with retained sensitivity ranges. This is configuration readiness, not runtime qualification.

producer.rule: Select longest canonical branch among positive-normal ocean-ocean candidates (stable branch-ID tie break); seed both cells adjacent to its segments; compute spherical distance across the entire connected ocean; age=160*(distance/max_distance)^exponent, with the exponent selected to satisfy ratified 70 Ma area-weighted median; no constant spreading-rate claim.
producer.full_support_validation_in_materializer: distance is required finite over every ocean cell; generated age is assigned to every cell where ocean mask is true; report records finite, nonnegative ages on all 50,542 ocean cells.

support_masks.M_ridge: M_ocean AND age == 0; 108 cells; exactly matches the 79 selected-source boundary segments' adjacent seed support
support_masks.M_positive_age: M_ocean AND finite(age) AND age > 0; 50,434 cells
support_masks.M_unselected_divergent_adjacent: unique ocean cells incident on at least one unselected positive-normal ocean-ocean candidate segment; 1,075 cells, including 3 cells in M_ridge and 1,072 cells in M_positive_age

ocean_support_authority.authority_basis: The T0 authorial ratification's OCEANIC_AGE_STATE governs a coherent, source-linked age field over ocean, age 0-160 Ma, median 70 Ma, sourced only from kinematically compatible oceanic candidates; it expressly permits other divergence to remain rift or unknown. The materializer applies that ratified age model across all connected ocean cells. The 1,072 cells have nonzero values from that governed producer. Their adjacency does not by itself contradict or invalidate the producer's specified whole-ocean age field.
ocean_support_authority.age_vs_boundary_process_distinction: Age authority is complete for these cells. Process identity for the 634 unselected candidate boundary segments remains unassigned; no candidate is promoted to ridge or active rift solely from kinematic sign. This boundary-process uncertainty is not a mask on the already-authorized positive age field under the ratified contract.

divergent_candidate_adjudication.adjudication: Do not infer ridge/rift from relative normal velocity. The governed age field uses the selected branch as its age origin and its authorial policy allows other divergence to remain rift or unknown. The candidate segments therefore remain process-unknown, while their adjacent positive-age cells retain AUTHORIZED_POSITIVE_AGE_OCEAN under the existing T0 age producer.
divergent_candidate_adjudication.kinematic_census_scope: T0 relative-motion diagnostics only; its own interpretation says local signs/components are not geological boundary-type assignments or physical accommodation laws.

remaining_unknown_support.effect_on_hwr2_cell_support: None under current ratified ocean-age producer contract; no cells excluded from age support on proximity alone.
remaining_unknown_support.policy: If future authorial physics says a subset of these boundaries reheats/reset ages or requires a distinct rift thermal model, that must arrive as an upstream T0 boundary-process/thermal-domain authority and a new derived thermal support mask. This closure does not infer such behavior.

upstream_t0_correction_required.for_1072_age_support: NONE; the existing ratified age-state contract and producer already authorize positive age over all connected ocean cells.
upstream_t0_correction_required.for_boundary_process_identity: No correction required to use governed positive ocean ages. Optional future boundary geology would require explicit authorial assignment of each relevant divergent candidate as spreading source, rift, or other/unknown, then a versioned T0 realization/materialization; it must not be guessed locally in the heat-flow producer.

hwr2_parameter_authority.primary_source_equation: Holdt et al. (2025), Eq. 4: H(t)=k*(T-T0)/zp*[1+2*sum(i=1..N, exp(-kappa*i^2*pi^2*t/zp^2))], kappa=k/(rho_m*Cp); valid here only for t>0. N is a convergence control.
hwr2_parameter_authority.selection_note: The user-authorized ARCANA authorial point selections below are reference values for this model candidate, not Earth inverse-fit defaults. Sensitivity ranges stay attached. Literature ranges are priors only, not evidence that ARCANA has Earth's composition.

parameters.name: k
parameters.source: Schuberth et al. (2009) mantle-convection benchmark uses 3.0 W m-1 K-1; Holdt et al. (2025) explores 3.2-4.1 W m-1 K-1 for HWR-2 calibration. https://doi.org/10.1029/2008GC002235 ; https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JB029890
parameters.reason: Select a common silicate-mantle effective value inside published model/material ranges, distinct from Holdt's Earth-fit optimum 3.8; retain broad interval because constant k collapses T/P dependence.
consumers: OrbData oceanic mantle conduc(2), explicit binding; crust conduc(1) remains a distinct crust material
parameters.uncertainty: Sensitivity interval retained; composition and T/P variability not resolved.

parameters.name: rho_m
parameters.source: Schuberth et al. (2009) and solid-Earth material-model tables use upper-mantle reference values near 3300-3370 kg m-3. https://doi.org/10.1029/2008GC002235 ; https://se.copernicus.org/articles/14/1155/2023/
parameters.reason: Select the standard silicate reference density for an Earth-radius/Earth-gravity ARCANA candidate; sensitivity range covers common mantle-model values.
consumers: OrbData mantle rhoBar(2) as the single shared reference density
parameters.uncertainty: Reference density only; pressure/temperature dependence is outside constant-property HWR-2.

parameters.name: Cp
parameters.source: Schuberth et al. (2009) uses 1134 J kg-1 K-1; Solid Earth 14 (2023) material table uses sub-lithospheric mantle 1250 J kg-1 K-1. https://doi.org/10.1029/2008GC002235 ; https://se.copernicus.org/articles/14/1155/2023/
parameters.reason: Select a round reference value within independent mantle-material model values; it is not an Earth heat-flow fit coefficient.
consumers: HWR-2 derived diffusivity; no independent OrbData Cp input is created
parameters.uncertainty: Sensitivity range retained; Cp(T,X) variation is collapsed in this model.

parameters.name: Tb
parameters.source: Holdt et al. (2025) summarizes independent mantle-temperature estimates of 1250-1464 C separately from the HWR-2 optimized fit. https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JB029890
parameters.reason: Choose 1680 K (1407 C) as an explicit ARCANA reference inside the independent petrologic prior and away from the HWR-2 optimum 1326 C. Sensitivity covers the reported independent range.
consumers: Shared OrbData mantle-reference consistency constraint at plate base; not numerically identical to an arbitrary adiabat control
parameters.uncertainty: Broad literature-prior interval; no ARCANA composition/petrology observation exists.

parameters.name: T0
parameters.source: Explicit ARCANA selection in this closure; no prior T0 climate boundary was canonical. Holdt's 0 C surface boundary is not transferred.
parameters.reason: Select 280 K as the model's fixed ocean-surface thermal reference; carry 250-300 K sensitivity because climate/atmosphere coupling is outside HWR-2.
consumers: OrbData TSurf where this same reference surface quantity is consumed
parameters.uncertainty: Authorial interval, not a climate prediction.

parameters.name: zp
parameters.source: Holdt et al. (2025) tabulates historical plate-model thickness estimates spanning roughly 90-136 km; this is model literature spread, including Earth calibration, not an adopted Earth fit. https://doi.org/10.1029/2024JB029890
parameters.reason: Select a round 100 km ARCANA thermal-plate reference, distinct from the HWR-2 optimum 105 km. Widen sensitivity interval to 80-140 km; do not read this as a measured ARCANA thickness.
consumers: HWR-2 plate thickness; producer thermal-isostatic subsidence; OrbData explicit ocean thermal-thickness binding

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.reason: Derived from the three selected shared material values; one quantity, no duplicate constant.
parameters.uncertainty: Correlated endpoint propagation required; do not vary independently.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.source: Solid Earth 14 (2023) material models use approximately 2.7-3.0e-5 K-1. https://se.copernicus.org/articles/14/1155/2023/
parameters.reason: Select one mantle expansivity reference for HWR-2 thermal subsidence and bind the same authority to OrbData alphaT(2). It does not enter Eq. 4 surface heat flow.
parameters.uncertainty: Sensitivity range retained; no second OrbData alpha value.

parameters.name: rho_w
parameters.source: Liquid-water reference; selected explicitly for the HWR thermal-subsidence relation, not part of the heat-flow Eq. 4.
parameters.reason: Bind the model's declared water-column density rather than leaving the subsidence denominator implicit.

parameters.name: N
parameters.sensitivity_range: N=128/256 endpoint comparison; target relative flux tolerance 1e-12
parameters.source: Explicit deterministic numerical selection; for the youngest positive age and slowest diffusivity/widest plate in the sensitivity domain, omitted tail at N=256 is below double-precision relevance.
parameters.reason: Fix deterministic truncation and tolerance for replay; N is not a physical material parameter.
parameters.uncertainty: Convergence must be recorded in producer replay metadata.

earth_fit_not_transferred: Holdt HWR-2 k optimum 3.8 W m-1 K-1
any Earth heat-flow/age fit residual or multiplier

The point values are explicit ARCANA authorial reference selections under this task's authorization; they are not claimed canonical planetary measurements.

parameter_sensitivity_envelope_w_m2.method: All endpoint combinations at both age endpoints evaluated; H(t) decreases monotonically with age for fixed positive parameter values. Reported interval bounds are sensitivity bounds, not extra point values.

including_parameter_sensitivity_w_m2.min_domain: positive-age ocean at 160 Ma, low-flux range corner
including_parameter_sensitivity_w_m2.max_domain: positive-age ocean at 1.1491667412337465 Ma, high-flux range corner

global_heat_flow_envelope.support: All 50,542 ocean cells are age-supported: 108 ridge boundary and 50,434 positive-age HWR-2 cells; continental ratified reference support retained.

qlim1_consequence.comparison: Nominal HWR-2 flux at youngest positive age is 0.4741482528 W m-2; sensitivity maximum is 0.5815390971 W m-2. Current qLim1 clips valid authorized ocean flux by at least 0.1741482528 W m-2 at the nominal youngest cell.
qlim1_consequence.reason: Although this authorial parameter selection supplies a finite model envelope, the current source operation must not silently cap explicit governed ARCANA flux. Preserve explicit ARCANA heatFl or fail closed on envelope violation. A future runtime guard must validate and report, not mutate; do not increase qLim1 arbitrarily.

gdh1_preservation_requirement.minimal_change: Gate the age-law assignment and age-zero qLim1 substitution to non-ARCANA mode. In ARCANA ocean mode, preserve supplied governed nonzero heatFl. Keep continental branch and legacy/no-ARCANA GDH1 behavior unchanged. Also bypass the independent hardcoded 95 km/GDH1 thickness assignment in ARCANA mode and bind the single selected 100 km producer thickness authority.
